title: HTTPS Server composition is a deployment constraint
summary: For ooRexx HTTPS Server v0.4.4, route bindings are immutable after the server has started. Therefore the current hosted activation strategy is compose-before-start: stage and load-test the module, include it in a new host composition, start/replace that host generation, then probe the actual endpoint.
invariants: Never report an HTTPS route live merely because its files exist beside a running host.
A hosted module using HttpResponse must directly require https_server.cls in the package where HttpResponse is referenced.
Sibling package imports do not automatically export package visibility into another sibling package.
The live endpoint probe occurs after the new host generation accepts the route.
If the host lifecycle changes in a future HTTPS Server version, update the adapter and this sphere rather than hard-coding MCP/Wire behavior in core Deployment.

provenance.claim: Documents compose-before-start and direct HTTPS package-binding requirements.
Qualified against real HTTPS Server v0.4.4, Wire UI Server v0.17 and Foreign Runtime v0.22.6.
